nodes.label: Animation build sequence
nodes.rationale: Seven ordered steps — should it animate, what purpose, cheapest tool, which properties, easing or spring, interruption and exit, reduced motion and pointer gating. The order matters because steps 1 and 2 gate everything: reaching for a curve before knowing whether it animates at all is the failure the sequence exists to prevent.

nodes.label: Frequency gate — should this animate at all
nodes.rationale: 100+ times a day gets no animation ever; tens a day gets near-imperceptible motion only; occasional gets standard; rare or first-time holds the delight budget. Keyboard-initiated actions are a disqualifier rather than a judgment call — Raycast has no open/close animation for exactly this reason. Producing zero lines of code is a success, not a dodge.

nodes.label: transform and opacity only
nodes.rationale: transform and opacity skip layout and paint and run on the GPU, while width, height, margin, padding, top and left trigger all three. clip-path is the sanctioned fourth and height is tolerated only for accordions. Never scale(0), since nothing in the real world appears from nothing; popovers scale from their trigger origin while modals stay centered; Motion's x/y/scale shorthands are not hardware accelerated.

nodes.label: Easing curves and duration budgets
nodes.source_location: 5. Easing and duration — or a spring
nodes.rationale: ease-out for entering and exiting, ease-in-out for on-screen movement, linear for constant motion; never ease-in on UI because it delays the moment the user is watching. Built-in CSS easings are too weak, so cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), (0.77, 0, 0.175, 1) and the iOS drawer curve (0.32, 0.72, 0, 1) are given exactly. UI animations stay under 300ms. Springs are for drag with momentum, interruptible gestures and elements that should feel alive.

nodes.label: Reduced motion and pointer gating ship with the animation
nodes.rationale: Reduced motion means fewer and gentler, not zero: keep transitions that aid comprehension and drop movement. Hover motion is gated behind (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) because touch fires false hovers on tap.

nodes.label: Never Ship table (web)
nodes.rationale: A self-check whose rows are each an automatic block in review-animations: transition: all, scale(0) entrances, ease-in on UI, animation on keyboard or high-frequency actions, over-300ms UI durations, centered transform-origin on anchored popovers, keyframes on rapidly-triggered elements, layout-property animation, ungated hover, missing reduced motion, everything entering at once.
